notes: GLB from Hunyuan is geometry-only — no UVs or PBR materials.
Use loadCharacter.js (copied next to assets) for front-projected color.
Back faces use a tint; multi-view generation needed for correct back geometry.
No skeleton or clips in this package — do not invent bones in Three.js.
